How we hire

Our hiring process has four stages and we aim to finish it within two weeks. We tell you where you stand after every stage, and we never ask for unpaid work beyond the take-home described below.

Stage one: intro screen

A thirty minute call with the hiring manager. We talk about what you have built and what you want next. No coding in this interview.

Stage two: take-home

A take home exercise that should take about three hours. You build a small ledger service and we read the code before the next round. We pay for the time if you would rather we did.

Stage three: system design

A ninety minute onsite or remote system design interview. You will design a payout pipeline with one of our engineers. We are listening for how you handle idempotency, partial failure and reconciliation.

Stage four: team fit

Two conversations with engineers you would work with, focused on how you collaborate, how you handle on-call, and what you expect from a manager.

We make a decision within two working days of the final stage. If we say no, we tell you the specific reason.
